name: proto-blocks/cadco-product-hero
title: Cadco Product Hero
description: The top of a product page: a breadcrumb, the product's photograph, its name, its introduction, the claims from its short description as bullets, the list price and a call to action. Everything is read from the product being viewed, so it is placed once in the single product template.

cta.label: Call to action
cta.help: The design's “Contact Cadco” button. Left out when it has no address.

shopTitle.label: Name for the whole catalogue
shopTitle.help: The breadcrumb's first step. Falls back to this only when the catalogue page cannot be resolved; otherwise that page's own title is used.

showGallery.label: Show the other gallery images
showGallery.help: Thumbnails under the main photograph, for a product whose gallery has more than one image. Nothing is shown for a product with a single photograph.

showPrice.label: Show the list price
showPrice.help: This catalogue lists prices but sells nothing, so the price is a list price, not an offer.

priceNote.label: Price label
priceNote.help: Optional, printed before the figure — e.g. “List price”. The design shows the figure alone.
